title: A Treatise on the Shaking Blow
summary: A treatise on blows that do their harm by shaking and not by weight and on the damped frame that survives a blow in return.

title: Canon of the Sundering Note
summary: A canon of the single note that finds the seam of a guard or a blade and parts it and of the ringing guard that answers a cut.

title: The Open Sky Resonance Canon
summary: A canon on spreading the qi field wide and letting it carry sound so that the student hears and strikes beyond arm's reach.

title: The Twin-Voice Treatise
summary: A treatise on two notes loosed together so that one opens the guard and the other lands and on the paired guard that holds against both.

title: Manual of the Hawk's Cry
summary: A manual of the high stooping cry of the hawk that bores through guards from above and warns of what lies ahead.

title: Compendium of the Azure Bell
summary: A compendium of the azure bell whose toll mends the hurt and shakes out poison and in the last extreme calls back a breath that has just stopped.

title: The Wind-Sworn Voice Reckoning
summary: A reckoning of the voice that a wind-sworn student pledges to the wind and the notes it answers with in cut and in guard.

title: Treatise on the Plateau Long Echo
summary: A treatise on the echo that carries across the open plateau and comes back at the caller with the weight of the whole field.

title: The Unwalled Silence
summary: A manual of the silence that has no walls and no end and that smothers a foe's voice and technique and eases the hurts of friends.
